text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unlike before, today's Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen is a sprint race... It will be a 
battle against the admired King-san...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To me, King-san is practically like a 
Prifight... but I won't back down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to learn from you... and 
understand what it truly means to be a 
princess!
